modalLead: The action bar, the views and Config now look like the rest of your theme: drawn like a category, in every material.

items.text: The action bar looks like a category. Beside the page, it takes the surface, edge and corners of your theme's material instead of the plate of a dialog.
Bookmarks, Inbox, Containers, Glances, Tags and Config are drawn like a category too, and the cards on them take the corners of the material.
